status: Stage 0 rules frozen before any trigger-target association was computed. Stage 1/2 decision rules frozen here; their technical addendum (request construction, fingerprints, plan) is frozen separately before any paid call and may not change any rule in this file.

authorisation.scope: E9 Stage 1 smoke and Stage 2 runs on the 118 development questions only; fail-closed

knowledge_before_freeze: Base rate of incomplete evidence is known in aggregate: ColQwen2 supplies all annotated evidence for 61/101 held-out questions after the GPT-4o-mini guard (E5).
docs/baseline_b1_specification.md states that 8 pages add complete evidence for at most 9/101 questions (notebook 07).
E8: grounding failure is anti-predictive of S-v1 correctness (P(wrong|fail) 0.39/0.43 vs P(wrong|pass) 0.67/0.63).
No association between any candidate signal below and evidence completeness has been computed or displayed before this freeze.

inputs.rankings: experiments/frozen/e5/tables/rankings.parquet (arm V, population held-out; full page ranking and MaxSim scores)
inputs.answer_side: experiments/frozen/e8 L-B1 replicate (abstention, numeric support) as re-derived in data/processed/mmlongbench_doc/b1/e8_evaluation_per_question.csv; checksums verified against the frozen package

populations.P0_labelled: held-out questions with at least one annotated evidence page (expected 101 questions, 14 documents). Unit: question; cluster: document.
populations.P_deploy: all 118 held-out questions (label-free; used only for thresholds and trigger rates)

targets.Y_incomplete: 1 if at least one annotated evidence page is not among ColQwen2's top 4 pages (B1 reads exactly the top 4 for all 118 questions in E8 L-B1). Primary.
targets.Y_recoverable: 1 if Y_incomplete and at least one missing annotated evidence page is at ColQwen2 rank 5-8. Secondary; used by the futility rule G5 and by the fallback rule.

signals.direction: higher value = more retrieval uncertainty = trigger. Scores s_i are ColQwen2 MaxSim scores sorted descending; s_1..s_8 the top eight.
signals.U2_top_standout: -(s_1 - mean(all page scores of the document)) / sd(all page scores, ddof=0)
signals.U4_abstained: 1 if the frozen E8 L-B1 reply is the exact abstention 'Not answerable', else 0
signals.U5_numeric_unsupported: 1 if the frozen E8 L-B1 numeric-support check is False, else 0 (not applicable counts as 0)

operating_point.continuous: trigger iff signal >= its 60th percentile over P_deploy (target trigger rate 40%, the proposal's cost assumption); the threshold uses no label

statistics.auroc: Mann-Whitney AUROC with mid-ranks for ties, signal against Y_incomplete on P0
statistics.bootstrap: document-cluster percentile bootstrap, 10,000 draws, numpy default_rng seed 20261126; documents resampled with replacement; draws in which Y_incomplete is constant are discarded and counted
statistics.p_value: one-sided bootstrap p = (1 + #draws with AUROC <= 0.5) / (1 + #valid draws)
statistics.multiplicity: Holm step-down over the 5 signals at familywise alpha 0.05
statistics.lift: precision at the operating point minus the base rate of Y_incomplete, computed within each bootstrap draw for its interval
statistics.lodo: AUROC recomputed with each of the 14 documents left out

gate.G3_materiality: lift >= +0.15 at the operating point, and the lift's 95% bootstrap lower bound > 0
gate.G5_futility: the triggered set contains at least 6 Y_recoverable questions (6/102 > the +0.05 engineering criterion)
gate.pass: Stage 0 passes iff at least one signal satisfies G1-G5. The selected trigger is the passing signal with the highest AUROC (ties: lowest signal index). Its threshold value is frozen with the Stage 0 result.

descriptive_only: AUROC within single-page and multi-page evidence strata
per-document trigger rates and base rates
trigger rate on the 16 unanswerable questions
counts of questions whose evidence becomes complete or partially recovered at k = 8

after_stage0.if_pass: Stage 1 smoke, then Stage 2 with arms B1s, F8a, F8b and derived A1a, A1b.
after_stage0.if_fail: Adaptive acquisition stops at $0 and is reported as a negative result. Fallback rule: the fixed-depth arms (B1s, F8a, F8b; no A1) run only if Y_recoverable >= 12 on P0. Reason: a +0.05 gain needs >= 6 net fixes (0.05 x 102 = 5.1), and with roughly half of evidence recoveries converting into correct answers, >= 12 recoverable questions are needed for the criterion to be reachable at all. Otherwise E9 closes without a paid call and B1 keeps k = 4.

stage1_smoke.purpose: validate the 8-page request path only: strict schema accepted, one served model, the token model reproduces observed prompt totals, cost within bound. Not scored.

stage2.population: the 118 development questions (102 answerable, 16 unanswerable) of E6/E8
stage2.reader: identical to E8 L-B1: gpt-6-luna, reasoning_effort none, temperature 0, image detail high, contract b1 (strict JSON schema), 800 maximum completion tokens, 768-px page images

arms.B1s: ColQwen2 top 4, one replicate in this session (118 calls). Same-session control; its requests must equal the frozen E8 L-B1 request fingerprints.
arms.F8b: repeat of F8a after all F8a/B1s pairs (118 calls); never served from F8a's cache
arms.A1a: derived, no call: F8a's reply on triggered questions, B1s's reply otherwise
arms.A1b: derived, no call: F8b's reply on triggered questions, B1s's reply otherwise

stage2.order: B1s and F8a adjacent per question, order counterbalanced 59/59 by a seeded permutation (seed 20261127); the F8b block after all pairs

primary_contrast.if_stage0_passed: A1 - B1s, answerable accuracy under S-v1, A1 averaged over replicates a and b per question
primary_contrast.if_fallback: F8 - B1s, answerable accuracy under S-v1, F8 averaged over replicates a and b per question

secondary: F8 - B1s and A1 - F8 (attribution), when A1 exists
each arm against the frozen E8 L-B1 and L-B1r (cross-session drift, descriptive)
S-v2 for every contrast once new gray items are labelled blind by the owner; never substituted by model judgment
correct abstentions, citation validity, schema validity, grounding diagnostic, tokens, USD, latency
decision_rules_in_order: Guardrails (each paid arm and each derived arm vs B1s): correct abstentions >= B1s - 2; citation validity >= B1s - 0.05; schema validity >= 0.99. Failure -> regression.
Broken > fixed / 2 in either replicate -> regression.
One-sided document-cluster bootstrap 5th percentile of Delta > 0 (10,000 draws, seed 20261128) and document sign-flip p <= 0.05 -> adopt_adaptive_acquisition (A1) or adopt_fixed_k8 (fallback).
stage2.engineering_criterion_both_replicates: Delta >= +0.05 must hold in replicate a and in replicate b separately, in addition to the replicate average
stage2.stability: correctness flips between F8a and F8b reported; more than 10 marks the arm unstable and blocks any adopt verdict
stage2.budget: cumulative observed cost ceiling 0.50 USD across Stage 1 and Stage 2, fail-closed; an attempt without returned usage is charged at its precomputed upper bound; SDK retries 0; stop on any served-model or system-fingerprint change

application_consequence: B1 changes only on an adopt verdict. Any adopted policy is then frozen for the final evaluation together with B1, and B1 remains the primary configuration if it is not adopted.
